messages.subject: Installation error on CentOS 6.5
parts:
I am attempting to install RHipe on CentOS 6.5 system which has CHD4 Hadoop 2.0.0-cdh4.5.0 installed on it as a pseudo-node. Installation of Hadoop works fine. I also went through the installation of protocol-buffer and it went fine too. I built R 3.0.2 as per the instructions - no problem there. But I am seeing a strange problem when installing RHipe itself.

What I don't understand is that even though I am specifying LD_LIBRARY_PATH to be  /usr/local/lib64/R/lib, RHipe is still attempting to install it at /usr/lib64/R/library and failing at the end. Even though the compiling and linking goes fine, it fails to copy the dynamic library (Rhipe.so).

Any suggestions will be appreciated.

- Anupam

messages.subject: Re: Installation error on CentOS 6.5
parts:
You just need to link protobuf
Do the following

Go to /etc/ld.so.conf.d/
create a file Protobuf-x86.conf
put /usr/local/lib in it
run ldconfig
and then rerun R CMD INSTALL and you should be good.
